purpose: Language-neutral behavior and persistence floor for replacing the standalone Python Canvas synchronization worker without feature loss.

result_projection_oracle.scope: 483 JSON field/value observations plus empty/full allowlists and exact large-integer persistence; not whole-worker parity or Python deletion approval

semantic_boundary.replacement_rule: The Rust executable may use any internal module or command layout; only the state, provider, persistence, privacy, liveness, and shutdown semantics in this contract are normative.

processor_loader.legacy_failure: Python startup failure for malformed path, import failure, missing attribute, or non-callable attribute
processor_loader.replacement_rule: The Rust worker links its processor directly; it does not preserve Python import syntax or dynamic module loading. Cutover removes CANVAS_SYNC_PROCESSOR from every deployment consumer.

database_adapter.replacement_rule: These are Python/SQLAlchemy implementation details, not required Rust driver configuration.

legacy_python_wiring.purpose: Inventory the currently deployed Python consumer so cutover can replace it deliberately; these strings are not a Rust API.

CANVAS_SYNC_WORKER_ID.normalization: non-empty configured value or generated unique identity

CANVAS_PORTABLE_INTEGRATION_ENABLED.effect_when_false: complete without provider reads using no_change=true

configuration.invalid_numeric_value: startup-or-processing-failure; never silently accept an invalid operator value

database.deployed_url_acceptance: accept the PostgreSQL URL forms supplied by Compose and Kubernetes without requiring an ORM-specific scheme
database.pooling: bounded; never create an unbounded number of connections
database.connectivity: detect unusable connections and fail safely without losing durable job state
database.parameter_redaction: connection parameters and SQL bind values never appear in logs or errors

ordering: await all outcomes without sibling cancellation
cycle.escaped_job_exception: log type only; retain durable lease for expiry recovery
cycle.cycle_exception: log and continue loop after bounded poll wait

due_schedule_transition.last_enqueued_at: now for every locked due target, including an active-job insert conflict
due_schedule_transition.next_run_at: now + max(60 seconds, target.schedule_seconds) for every locked due target, including an active-job insert conflict
due_schedule_transition.scheduled_counter: count only newly inserted jobs; an active-job conflict contributes zero

scheduling_and_leasing.expired_nonfinal_lease: retry with canvas_worker_lease_expired and normal job backoff
scheduling_and_leasing.expired_final_lease: dead_letter with canvas_worker_lease_expired and disable target

heartbeats.readiness_freshness: latest heartbeat for role within caller-provided maximum age

shutdown.in_flight_cycle: allowed to finish unless task cancellation is requested
shutdown.lease_maintenance_task: cancel and await after every terminal or fenced outcome

target_validation.tenant_scope: platform and binding must belong to target organization and binding must reference platform
target_validation.active_scope: target, platform, and binding enabled and not archived

job_outcomes.processing_error: preserve stable code, bounded safe summary, retryability, and Retry-After

success.marks_target_success: CAS by organization, target, config version, enabled=true
success.target_success_cas_loss: job remains succeeded; do not overwrite reconfigured target

job_outcomes.manual_retry: dead-letter only, rollout gate open, reset durable job through repository transition
job_outcomes.manual_resolve: dead-letter only, acknowledge while target remains stopped

job.retry_after: maximum of computed delay and Retry-After

oauth_revocation.retry_after: maximum of computed delay and Retry-After

http_mapping.429: retryable rate limit with bounded Retry-After
http_mapping.401_with_www_authenticate: mark the still-current OAuth connection for reauthorization using CAS
http_mapping.malformed_success: unavailable observation; never a verified negative

nrps.use: roster discovery only; never issuance evidence

origin_and_network_security.normalized_origin: lower-case hostname, no trailing dot, omit port 443
origin_and_network_security.runtime_dns_failure_or_empty_answer: fail closed before request in every environment
origin_and_network_security.dns_rebinding_control: connect to a validated resolved IP while retaining original Host and TLS SNI; use a separate pool per original origin

signing_service_access.current_python_response_detail: text detail is sliced to 500 characters; JSON string or object detail is not bounded
signing_service_access.required_security_hardening: bound serialized JSON and text response detail before propagating, persisting, or logging it; prove this first in the Python oracle and then share the fixture with Rust

resolution.verification_method: exact child of configured issuer DID
resolution.public_key: RSA public JWK only; reject every private JWK parameter

lti_signing.sign_request: DID-mediated; never send profile id, signing service id, or provider key reference
lti_signing.sign_response: issuer DID, algorithm, and verification method must exactly match; reject private routing identifiers; require raw signature
lti_signing.readiness: sign and locally verify a challenge against exactly one matching published public JWK

integration_secret_compatibility.master_key: standard base64 encoding of exactly 32 bytes
integration_secret_compatibility.cross_language: Rust must decrypt existing Python ciphertext and Python-compatible Rust ciphertext without re-encryption
integration_secret_compatibility.read_projection: plaintext returned only to the provider adapter; update last_used_at
integration_secret_compatibility.logs_and_debug: never expose master key, plaintext, ciphertext, or secret-bearing metadata

application_reconciliation.requirements: validate every typed binding evidence requirement
application_reconciliation.identity: verified LTI subject required; Canvas REST additionally requires linked numeric identity
application_reconciliation.failed_read: retain previous evidence head and warning; do not synthesize a negative
application_reconciliation.rate_limit: finish safe local patches then return canvas_rate_limited using maximum Retry-After
application_reconciliation.evidence_identity: deterministic logical key from platform, binding, application, requirement, and subject
application_reconciliation.idempotency: reuse an identical current evidence revision; create only changed revisions
application_reconciliation.policy: re-evaluate through authoritative evidence revision service

evidence_preconditions: fact organization and application equal the locked application
single_transaction: append or reuse immutable evidence revision
advance head only when the observation is newer
lock the one open correction review
evaluate previous and current policy in the canonical Rust policy kernel
create, update, recover, or mark the review
atomic_evidence_and_correction_review.revision_identity: source revision and immutable fact identity make replay idempotent
atomic_evidence_and_correction_review.out_of_order_revision: retain immutable history but never replace a newer current head

review_creation.condition: a changed head moves an issued application from allowed to denied and no open review exists

atomic_evidence_and_correction_review.review_denial_update: update current decision and triggering fact while retaining original prior-decision baseline

automatic_recovery.condition: an unclaimed open review observes an allowed current decision

manual_resolution.claim: application-row lock plus compare-and-set open + unclaimed -> random claim token/action/timestamp
manual_resolution.single_side_effect: only the winning claim may invoke suspend or revoke
manual_resolution.handler_failure: owner releases claim back to open

recovery_during_manual_claim.evidence_commit: still append evidence and its audit event
recovery_during_manual_claim.review_update: update current decision and set resolution_recovery_pending when policy is allowed
recovery_during_manual_claim.successful_manual_handler: manual action remains authoritative and clears recovery marker on finalize
recovery_during_manual_claim.failed_manual_handler: release claim, then claim as evidence_recovered and atomically resolve with audit event

atomic_evidence_and_correction_review.rollback: any persistence, transition, review, or audit failure rolls back the complete evidence transaction

background_roster_reconciliation.retained_roster_identity: numeric Canvas id or opaque LTI subject only; never name or email
background_roster_reconciliation.mixed_source_join: linked identity must join numeric user and active NRPS subject or state is identity_link_required
background_roster_reconciliation.eligible_transition: all required current observations satisfy their typed pass rules -> pending_claim
background_roster_reconciliation.observation_revision: sha-256 of canonical assertion and bounded source payload
background_roster_reconciliation.signing: forbidden; candidate preparation ends at pending_claim

issued_drift.expired_window: disable target and succeed with no_change=true
issued_drift.correction_behavior: authoritative evidence and policy may create lifecycle review; never directly sign

oauth_revocation.failure: owner-fenced reschedule; increment retry count; retain connection and secrets
oauth_revocation.platform_patch_failure: log and still delete secrets because remote revoke and connection deletion are complete
oauth_revocation.owner_fence_loss: do not count or delete secrets

jobs.lease_constraint: leased iff owner and expiry are non-null
jobs.active_unique_index: one target_id where status in queued, leased, retry

durable_result_privacy.error_summary: collapse whitespace and truncate to 500 characters
durable_result_privacy.unexpected_error_summary: exception class only; never exception text or response body
durable_result_privacy.current_python_logging_gap: logger.exception emits exception messages and tracebacks on worker failure paths and can leak provider or secret-bearing detail
durable_result_privacy.required_security_hardening: replace or sanitize exception logging so only allowlisted structured fields and exception class are emitted; establish Python oracle coverage before using shared redaction fixtures
log_forbidden: exception message from an unexpected provider failure

postgres_lease_recovery.name: final_attempt_completion_race
postgres_lease_recovery.rule: completion and expiry-recovery are fenced by one row lock and current lease generation; the loser observes terminal or stale state and cannot overwrite it

existing_rust_components.rule: Refactor or extend these shared components; do not introduce a second OAuth, integration-secret cipher/vault, or readiness implementation for the worker.

oauth_differences_to_resolve.legacy_python_retry: pending-revocation polling, typed error codes, exponent cap 11, base cap 21600 seconds, random jitter through 25 percent, total cap 86400 seconds
oauth_differences_to_resolve.current_rust_disconnect_retry: request-path attempt only, generic canvas_oauth_revoke_failed, exponent cap 7, base cap 3600 seconds, no jitter, no pending-queue worker
oauth_differences_to_resolve.legacy_python_cleanup: owner-fenced connection delete, best-effort platform patch, then per-secret deletion outside that transaction
oauth_differences_to_resolve.current_rust_postgres_cleanup: owner-fenced connection and tenant-scoped secret deletion in one transaction, followed by platform patch
oauth_differences_to_resolve.required_resolution: Use the existing Rust repository/vault and keep its stronger atomic tenant-scoped cleanup, while adding worker-owned due selection, lease/retry/error parity and preserving the externally observed platform projection. Differential tests must explicitly approve any ordering improvement.

rust_start_requires: contract approved as the complete behavior and persistence boundary
all legacy oracle gaps below implemented against the Python source
fresh PostgreSQL fixtures for leases, recovery, target CAS, OAuth revocation, and heartbeat projection
provider simulators for REST, AGS, NRPS, OAuth refresh, and OAuth revocation
language-neutral fixtures consumable by both Python oracle and Rust candidate
exact provenance pins verified against the protected Python snapshot and the Rust base snapshot
existing Rust canvas_oauth, canvas_oauth_postgres, integration_secret, and readiness components selected for reuse or refactor
python_deletion_requires: whole-worker differential parity including mutation and failure cases
same database migration ownership and rollback evidence
all Compose, self-host, and Kubernetes consumers routed to Rust
no production or persistent self-host change without separate approval
legacy_oracle_gaps: worker environment parsing, clamping, and malformed-number startup behavior
legacy Python processor loader malformed path/import/non-callable behavior before cutover; Rust must instead remove CANVAS_SYNC_PROCESSOR from every consumer
loop stop-event, cancellation, cycle-exception recovery, and engine disposal
lease renewal heartbeat and renewal-fence loss
PostgreSQL concurrent scheduler, lease reclaim, and final-attempt crash recovery
safe-result exhaustive type, truncation, and negative-integer projection
Retry-After HTTP-date, malformed, negative, and clamp edges
all target validation codes and processor async/result-shape failures
OAuth revocation rate-limit/timeout classification, Retry-After, patch failure, and owner-fence loss
background cursor resume/wrap plus terminal candidate-state preservation across cycles
complete per-fact assertion parity for assignment, quiz, module, and course evidence
bound JSON string/object signing-service error detail in Python (text is currently the only 500-character bounded case) before sharing the security fixture with Rust
replace Python worker logger.exception message/traceback leakage with allowlisted structured logging and add redaction oracle coverage before sharing fixtures with Rust
